Steady like a weaned child

Same heart as Steady Days for Families—plain week, honest soul.

Read-aloud

Not every week has fireworks. Sometimes the bravest thing is letting your heart be quiet with God instead of noisy inside.

Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul is even as a weaned child. Psalm 131:2 (KJV)

That is not giving up joy—it is learning to rest your soul on God like a sleepy child rests on someone who loves them.

Gentle question

When did your soul feel most “weaned” and quiet this week—or what would help it feel that way for one minute?

Short prayer together

Lord, teach us steady souls on plain days. Thank You for small mercies we almost missed. Amen.

Coloring idea

Morning light through a window, a mug, an open Bible—peace before the schedule runs. Try Verse Image with Morning window (T19).
